findings.impact: On wide viewports and at high zoom the sticky top court-scrollbar tracks a shorter distance than the actual board, so dragging it fully right stops short of the last courts.
findings.title: Sticky top scrollbar spacer width (72 + n*310 px) can desync from the real grid width (72px + n*minmax(310px,1fr))

```ts
const getMessageFallback = () =>
  locale === 'vi' ? 'Nội dung đang được cập nhật.' : 'Content is being updated.';
```
Three call sites in the manage page already defend against this with Vietnamese-only `||` fallbacks — manage/page.tsx:1987 `{translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, manage/page.tsx:2109 `aria-label={translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, and BasicInfoTab.tsx:447 `{translate('hideBannerText') || 'Ẩn chữ phủ trên banner công khai'}` — none of which can ever fire, because next-intl never returns an empty string for a present key.
findings.impact: Any future missing key is silently replaced by the generic sentence rather than failing loudly, so a catalogue regression ships a user-facing placeholder ('Content is being updated.') inside a form label or button with no test or type error. (No missing key exists in the set I sampled, so this is latent risk, not a live bug.)
findings.title: Missing translation keys are silently masked by a generic fallback string, hiding catalogue gaps
